title: Gary and Nina get an Executive Office in the virtual office
description: The No department room is gone. Gary and Nina have an Executive Office, anybody with no department sits there with them, and on weekdays from 8 AM to 5 PM Gary and Nina are in the office whether or not they timed in.
items: They work at their desks, then go round each department and stop to talk to each person who is in
They keep meeting Amier and Joel on the main corridor through the day
Once a day they sit down with Amier and Joel at the Executive Office table for 30 minutes, at a different time each day

Every department now has an hour's team meeting in its own room each weekday, for whoever has timed in, plus Amier and Joel, who do not need to. VizBytes is Monday to Wednesday 10 to 11 AM and Thursday and Friday 1:30 to 2:30 PM, and the others change from day to day
They talk to the guard in the lobby, go out of the front doors, and come back
Everyone can see into the Executive Office and sees Gary and Nina by name
They only stop at rooms you can see into. A department closed to you stays closed
None of this touches the DTR, so if they have not timed in, their record still says so
